title: Differentiable normal linearization of partially hyperbolic dynamical systems
summary: A result on $C^0$ linearization which is differentiable at the hyperbolic fixed point is known. In this paper, we further investigate a partially hyperbolic diffeomorphism $F$ to find a local $C^0$ conjugacy, which is $C^1$ on the center manifold, to linearize the hyperbolic component (normal to the center direction) and obtain its Takens' normal form. Our result is optimal, as it needs no non-resonant condition usually required for smooth conjugacy (e.g., as in the Takens' theorem) and the $C^{1,α}$ $(α>0)$ smoothness condition is sharp.
